title: Premier Cru Selection Analysis
description: Explore the key Premier Crus and their differences from Grand Crus, plus investment value

lessons.0.slides.0.title: The Premier Cru System

lessons.0.slides.0.description: Understand the definition, standards, and classification logic of Premier Cru
lessons.0.slides.1.title: What Is a Premier Cru?
lessons.0.slides.1.content: Premier Cru is the second tier in the Burgundy classification, representing high quality that falls just short of Grand Cru. Burgundy has approximately 640 Premier Crus, totalling around 3,500 ha — about 10% of the entire appellation.
lessons.0.slides.2.title: 🏅 Premier Cru Characteristics
lessons.0.slides.2.points.0: Label: village name + Premier Cru vineyard name
lessons.0.slides.2.points.2: May also be labelled 'Village + Premier Cru' (blended from multiple plots)
lessons.0.slides.2.points.3: Yield limit: 40–48 hl/ha (slightly higher than Grand Cru)
lessons.0.slides.2.points.5: Ageing potential: 8–20 years (depending on plot and vintage)
lessons.0.slides.3.title: Premier Cru vs. Grand Cru
lessons.0.slides.4.title: 🌟 The Value of Premier Cru
lessons.0.slides.4.points.0: Value for money: quality close to Grand Cru at a more accessible price
lessons.0.slides.4.points.1: Diversity: every village has its own distinctive Premier Crus
lessons.0.slides.4.points.2: Accessibility: much easier to source than Grand Cru
lessons.0.slides.4.points.3: Investment potential: top producers' Premier Crus appreciate quickly
lessons.0.slides.4.points.4: Drinking pleasure: usually ready to drink earlier than Grand Cru
lessons.0.slides.5.title: Why Have Some Premier Crus Not Been Elevated to Grand Cru?
lessons.0.slides.5.content: Reasons include: historical factors (political considerations at the time of classification), parcels too small to be representative, terroir slightly below Grand Cru standard but still outstanding, producer quality insufficiently consistent. Yet many Premier Crus (e.g. Meursault Les Perrières) already reach Grand Cru quality in practice.

lessons.1.slides.1.title: Gevrey-Chambertin Premier Crus
lessons.1.slides.1.content: Gevrey has 26 Premier Crus covering approximately 80 ha. Although the Grand Crus shine brightest, the finest Premier Crus are not to be underestimated.
lessons.1.slides.2.title: 🏆 Gevrey's Finest Premier Crus
lessons.1.slides.2.points.0: Clos Saint-Jacques — closest to Grand Cru, adjacent to Chambertin
lessons.1.slides.2.points.1: Les Cazetiers — elegant and refined, on the upper slope
lessons.1.slides.2.points.3: Aux Combottes — small but outstanding, adjacent to Grand Crus
lessons.1.slides.2.points.5: Note: Clos Saint-Jacques frequently fetches more than some Grand Crus

lessons.1.slides.4.title: Chambolle-Musigny Premier Crus
lessons.1.slides.4.content: Chambolle has 24 Premier Crus, all characteristically elegant and refined. With only 2 Grand Crus, the Premier Crus are the main gateway to exploring the Chambolle style.

lessons.1.slides.5.points.4: Aux Beaux Bruns — on a steeper section of slope

lessons.1.slides.7.title: Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Crus
lessons.1.slides.7.content: Nuits-Saint-Georges has no Grand Cru but boasts 41 Premier Crus covering 143 ha. Premier Crus here set the quality benchmark for the entire village.
lessons.1.slides.8.title: 💎 Nuits-Saint-Georges' Finest Premier Crus
lessons.1.slides.8.points.0: Les Saint-Georges — the village's namesake, highest quality
lessons.1.slides.8.points.1: Les Vaucrains — powerful and concentrated, firm tannins
lessons.1.slides.8.points.5: Investment note: these Premier Crus from top producers merit long-term holding
lessons.1.slides.9.title: Map of Nuits-Saint-Georges' Top Premier Crus

lessons.1.slides.10.title: Value Recommendation
lessons.1.slides.10.content: Côte de Nuits Premier Crus offer far better value than Grand Crus. Strategy: choose Premier Crus from top producers such as Dujac and Armand Rousseau — quality approaches Grand Cru but at just one-third to one-half the price.

lessons.2.slides.1.title: Meursault Premier Crus

lessons.2.slides.2.points.5: Poruzots — a more powerful, structured Meursault
lessons.2.slides.2.points.6: Goutte d'Or — 'Drop of Gold', fullest and roundest

lessons.3.slides.1.title: 💡 Principles for Selecting Premier Cru
lessons.3.slides.1.points.0: Priority order: top producer > renowned PC > good vintage
lessons.3.slides.1.points.1: Know the plot: research each Premier Cru's location and terroir
lessons.3.slides.1.points.2: Compare prices: the same plot varies enormously by producer
lessons.3.slides.1.points.3: Vintage selection: Premier Crus shine in great vintages
lessons.3.slides.1.points.4: Trustworthy source: ensure authenticity and correct storage
lessons.3.slides.1.points.5: Balance your cellar: Premier Crus should make up 50–70% of your collection
lessons.3.slides.2.title: 🏆 Premier Crus Most Worth Investing In
lessons.3.slides.2.points.0: Côte de Nuits reds: Clos Saint-Jacques, Les Amoureuses
lessons.3.slides.2.points.1: Côte de Beaune whites: Meursault Perrières, Puligny Pucelles
lessons.3.slides.2.points.2: Côte de Beaune reds: Pommard Rugiens, Volnay Caillerets
lessons.3.slides.2.points.3: Value pick: Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Crus are underrated
lessons.3.slides.2.points.4: Emerging: fine Premier Crus from Fixin and Savigny
lessons.3.slides.2.points.5: Long hold: 10–15 years generates strong returns
lessons.3.slides.3.title: Investment Strategy Comparison
lessons.3.slides.4.title: 📊 Price Reference (750 ml)
lessons.3.slides.4.points.5: Prices vary enormously by producer and vintage
lessons.3.slides.5.title: ⚠️ Pitfalls to Avoid
lessons.3.slides.5.points.0: Don't rely on plot name alone — producer matters more
lessons.3.slides.5.points.4: Don't drink too early — allow at least 5–8 years
lessons.3.slides.5.points.5: Avoid buying plots you don't understand just because everyone else is
lessons.3.slides.6.title: The True Value of Premier Cru
lessons.3.slides.6.content: Premier Cru is the ideal gateway to Burgundy: a relatively accessible price point, outstanding quality, and a genuine way to experience terroir differences. For most enthusiasts, building a collection centred on top Premier Crus is more practical and more rewarding than chasing sky-high Grand Crus.
